summary: 21 visitors stranded overnight at the bottom of East Portal Road after thunderstorms triggered mudslides off the 2025 South Rim Fire burn scar, burying the road in up to 6 ft of mud, rocks and boulders; NPS law enforcement and NPS/Bureau of Reclamation facility crews evacuated 18 by midnight and the remaining 3 by 9:00 a.m. July 17; no injuries.
location: East Portal Road (six-mile access road to Crystal Dam/Gunnison Tunnel), Curecanti National Recreation Area
responding_agency: NPS law enforcement; Bureau of Reclamation
notes: Run 864: NPS July-17 press-release coverage via Unofficial Networks (parent-opened); Fox31 video and travelers coverage corroborate per UN. Jurisdiction framed as Curecanti NRA; road sits at the bottom of Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP. Chunk: NPS CURE.
